templates.name: Winter 2027 - PTA / PTO officers (direct ask) - Intro
templates.subject: Indoor winter favorites for {school name} families
templates.body:
Hi {school name} PTA team,

Looking for indoor after-school options this winter? Players Sports Academy (PSA) brings our winter favorites right to your school:
- Chess
- Coding
- Speech & Debate
- Indoor sports: Basketball, Volleyball and Ping Pong

Our full sports lineup is always available too. Programs run once a week for 6–8 weeks, right after dismissal.

I'm {my name} with PSA, a Northern Virginia nonprofit that already partners with elementary schools across Fairfax and Loudoun. The setup is simple:
- No cost to the school. Families register directly, and we share revenue back with your PTA.
- No extra work for you. Our background-checked coaches bring all the equipment and handle registration, rosters and pickup.

Would {school name} like a winter program? I'm happy to set up a quick 10-minute call or send over a one-page overview, whichever is easier.

Thank you,
{my name}
Players Sports Academy
{my email} · thepsasports.com

- Chess
- Coding
- Speech & Debate
- Basketball
- Volleyball
- Ping Pong
